positive.prompt: Turn this into a JsonLogic rule: give 20% off orders over $200
Is this a valid JsonLogic expression? {"if": [{">": [{"var": "age"}, 18]}, "adult", "minor"]}
Run this JsonLogic rule against sample data in Python and show me the result

negative.prompt: Write a general JavaScript function that checks if a user is an adult
Explain how JSON Schema validation works

evals.prompt: I have orders with fields total and coupon_code. Give a JsonLogic rule for 20% off when total is over $200, and show me it running against {"total": 250, "coupon_code": null}.
evals.expected_output: A JsonLogic rule using > and var on total, run against the given sample data with the discount result shown
expectations: Confirms or uses the given field names (total, coupon_code) rather than inventing new ones
Produces a well-formed JsonLogic rule using the > and var operators
Executes the rule against the supplied sample data and shows the actual result
States which language/library was used to run it
